propDocs.PasswordInput.visible: Controls visibility; update with onVisibleChange so the eye toggle remains interactive.
propDocs.PasswordInput.disabled: Disables the field and its toggle.
propDocs.PasswordInput.readOnly: Prevents editing while leaving visibility toggling available.
propDocs.PasswordInput.required: Requires a password before form submission.
propDocs.PasswordInputToggle.children: Optional custom icon or render function of the visible state.
